summary: This configuration block sets up a GitLab Runner that uses Docker to execute jobs. It specifies that jobs should run in a PHP 8.4 container and mounts special volumes so the container can access the Docker daemon and the build files from the host machine.

explanations.1: The double square brackets indicate this is an array of configuration sections; you can have multiple runners defined this way.
explanations.4: This creates a nested array under the runners section specifically for Docker-related settings.
explanations.8: The volumes array uses three dots to represent other volume mounts (which aren't shown), then adds two specific mounts: the first lets the container talk to Docker on the host machine, and the second makes the build directory accessible inside the container.
